title: Kaigo Rules product-value metrics v0.1
purpose: Measure whether structured repository data becomes usable public product coverage without collapsing provenance, service scope, verification, currentness, or human-review states.
global_guards: These are repository-state coverage metrics, not claims about human task time, user effectiveness, clinical correctness, or legal advice quality.
A complete verification state means the relevant state is explicitly represented; it does not mean PASS, HUMAN_VERIFIED, or VERIFIED_CURRENT.
Verification or publication state from one service must never be inherited by another service.
Relations lacking independent audit coverage are counted as unresolved/unverified, not as incorrect.

metrics.label: Practical questions with an evidence path

numerator.criterion: question has at least one resolvable evidence path to an official source or canonical authority node
accepted_paths: rule_node_ids[] resolves to data/rule-nodes.json and that node resolves to an official source
notice_node_ids[] resolves to data/notice-nodes.json and that node resolves to an official source
qa_item_ids[] resolves to data/qa-items.json and that item resolves to an official source

guards: questions.status=verified alone does not satisfy the evidence-path criterion
FAQ presentation-support data is not treated as canonical layer-wide verification

metrics.label: Public items with source, scope, and verification-state completeness

denominator.selector: items reachable through currently enabled public routes for a service
denominator.service_boundary: data/services/manifest.json plus the selected service config; services with public routes disabled are excluded from the public-item denominator

numerator.criterion: public item satisfies source_complete AND scope_complete AND verification_state_complete
numerator.source_complete: an official source reference or canonical source-chain reference resolves
numerator.scope_complete: the item is explicitly in the selected service scope; shared-source content must have an explicit service-scope mapping
numerator.verification_state_complete: the relevant layer or item exposes explicit content-verification, currentness, and human-review state, even when a state is HOLD, NOT_STARTED, NOT_REVIEWED, or equivalent

guards: PASS is not required for state completeness
HOLD or NOT_REVIEWED is complete state representation when explicitly recorded
service scope must not be inferred from another service

metrics.label: Unresolved or unverified semantic/cross-layer relations

denominator.scope: non-contains semantic or cross-layer relations tracked by the verification registry

numerator.criterion: relation is in the tracked semantic/cross-layer inventory and is not covered by an independent relation-verification lane

guards: source-derived structural contains relations are excluded from this metric
automatic promotion to verified is forbidden
